The community

Not a gated community. Not a standard subdivision.

In the heart of the Calamuchita Valley, surrounded by the Córdoba sierras and minutes from the Los Molinos Reservoir. True luxury here is measured in silence, pure air, open views and quality of life — not in built square meters.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is this a gated community?

No. It is a self-sustainable residential community with private access, designed for living with space, privacy and nature.

How many lots are there and what size are they?

There are 12 exclusive lots of 1,000 m² each, starting at 58,000 USD.

Until when is the pre-sale price available?

The published price applies to the pre-sale, available until December 12, for a limited time.

What does the Club House include?

Swimming pool with solarium, gym, spa, and padel, tennis and volleyball courts.

How far is Córdoba International Airport?

1 hour 20 minutes by road (94 km).

Nikki Bueno

Three decades of dedicated expertise

Nikki Bueno brings more than three decades of dedicated expertise in holistic wellness, combining advanced quantum technology with intuitive energy healing. Originally from California, she has owned and operated three successful healing centers across Los Angeles and Santa Barbara, California, as well as Cuernavaca, Morelos, Mexico.

As an early pioneer of quantum biofeedback technology since 2001, Nikki specializes in facilitating deep healing transformations for clients dealing with chronic conditions.

Having lived and worked in Latin America for over 20 years, she is fully bilingual in English and Spanish. Her deep cultural fluency and linguistic mastery allow her to bridge communication gaps seamlessly, offering an exceptionally supportive environment for international clients and local communities alike.
